policy: Evidence/component changes feed the Overall audit; they do not raw-sort the board. Decisions preserve 1-QB strategy, positional scarcity, ceiling, role, availability, reliability and nearby-player opportunity cost.

decisions.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
decisions.reason: Workload/ceiling improved with Pacheco out, but Bijan remains the only player clearly ahead; no forced move.

decisions.name: Puka Nacua
decisions.reason: Psoas plus unresolved off-field/league-review risk warrants a controlled one-slot downgrade; elite role and ceiling prevent a larger fall.

decisions.name: De'Von Achane
decisions.reason: Expanded centerpiece role improves production and ceiling, but durability/bust risk caps the move at one slot.

decisions.name: Nico Collins
decisions.reason: Target consolidation after Higgins loss/Dell uncertainty strengthens an already elite role.

decisions.name: A.J. Brown
decisions.reason: Maye chemistry and new-offense integration reduce transition uncertainty; one-slot improvement is sufficient.

decisions.name: Chris Olave
decisions.reason: Tyson absence consolidates targets; modest move because existing profile already prices a strong role.

decisions.name: Emeka Egbuka
decisions.reason: Toe/Week 1 uncertainty lowers near-term availability enough for a controlled two-slot slide.

decisions.name: DJ Moore
decisions.reason: Allen chemistry plus intermediate/red-zone integration meaningfully improves Buffalo fit and ceiling.

decisions.name: Rashee Rice
decisions.reason: Removing the discipline penalty restores value; knee/reconditioning risk prevents a larger jump.

decisions.name: Jaylen Waddle
decisions.reason: Explosive Nix connection and demonstrated Denver role justify a modest rise.

decisions.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
decisions.reason: Repeated Lawrence trust/timing/red-zone chemistry is a meaningful multi-component improvement, not generic camp praise.

decisions.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
decisions.reason: Kamara absence creates substantial early-season lead-back opportunity while preserving season-long role uncertainty.

decisions.name: Jeremiyah Love
decisions.reason: Active ankle reevaluation creates early-season availability risk; ceiling remains intact.

decisions.name: Sam LaPorta
decisions.reason: Hip flare after back surgery adds availability/reliability risk and warrants a modest slide.

decisions.name: Parker Washington
decisions.reason: Strong camp ascension and improved Lawrence connection outweigh the temporary missed-practice episode; five-slot rise reflects the stronger role without treating him as Jacksonville WR1.

decisions.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
decisions.reason: Positive LaFleur usage/red-zone integration improves role confidence; prior uncertainty still caps the move.

decisions.name: Josh Jacobs
decisions.reason: Commissioner Exempt List removes immediate practice/game availability with uncertain return timing; large but controlled fall.

decisions.name: Josh Downs
decisions.reason: Confirmed top-two receiver hierarchy strengthens role security.

decisions.name: Patrick Mahomes II
decisions.reason: Full clearance and strong camp restore part of the ACL/LCL recovery discount. 1-QB opportunity cost prevents ranking him like an equally scored RB/WR; 74 also aligns with the prior board-audit target before the latest recovery evidence.

decisions.name: Alec Pierce
decisions.reason: PUP activation plus top-two Colts receiver role removes temporary availability discount and strengthens usage confidence.

decisions.name: Tyler Allgeier
decisions.reason: Arizona backfield injuries increase near-term opportunity; role remains contingent, so move is limited.

decisions.name: MarShawn Lloyd
decisions.reason: Jacobs absence creates immediate lead-back competition and meaningful contingent value.

decisions.name: Blake Corum
decisions.reason: Improved explosiveness/agility after a 2025 breakout raises standalone ceiling and pressure on Kyren while preserving Kyren as lead back.

decisions.name: Jonathon Brooks
decisions.reason: Continued unavailability entering the season keeps availability/production below the current placement.

decisions.name: Mike Washington Jr.
decisions.reason: Strong system fit plus Jeanty contingency creates actionable late-round opportunity, but role remains secondary when Jeanty is healthy.

decisions.name: Daniel Jones
decisions.reason: Full Achilles recovery and nearly all first-team Colts reps materially improve role/availability confidence; 1-QB format caps the move.

decisions.name: Chris Bell
decisions.reason: Reinstatement from NFI restores availability versus the prior inactive state.

decisions.name: Alvin Kamara
decisions.reason: MCL absence remains a major early-season availability hit; low current placement limits practical downside.

decisions.name: Isiah Pacheco
decisions.reason: IR guarantees at least four missed games and return/workload remain uncertain.

decisions.name: Kyler Murray
decisions.reason: Minnesota starter designation resolves role uncertainty in a favorable offense, but 1-QB strategy prevents an aggressive overall jump.

decisions.name: Jonnu Smith
decisions.reason: Green Bay role is less secure than prior expectation and Kraft remains ahead; modest late-board downgrade.

decisions.name: Jordyn Tyson
decisions.reason: Hamstring absence of roughly two months destroys near-term usability and lowers season-long expected production.

decisions.name: Tyler Shough
decisions.reason: Confirmed starting role adds real QB value, but 1-QB format keeps the move late in the board.

decisions.name: C.J. Stroud
decisions.reason: Loss of Higgins is a real environment downgrade, but at this already extreme 1-QB discount there is no useful additional Overall movement.

decisions.name: Jayden Higgins
decisions.reason: Season-ending ACL tear leaves no 2026 redraft value; move to final slot.
